fields.label: Field
fields.description: A field of the record, of the record it links to, or the one summed.

fields.label: Through
fields.description: The record's own link to the one whose field is shown.

fields.label: Counting
fields.description: Filters on what is counted. A value may name the record's fields as {{ doc.fieldname }}.

fields.label: Measure
fields.description: A measure a module registered by name. It may say its own label, tone and link.

fields.label: Shown When
fields.description: Filters on the record, as a list filter writes them. Empty shows it always.

fields.label: Leads To
fields.description: Where the number leads. It may name the record's fields as {{ doc.fieldname }}.

fields.label: Hide When Empty
fields.description: Not shown when it comes to nothing. Otherwise an empty value shows as a dash.

fields.label: Tone
fields.description: How it reads. Quiet for nothing to do, waiting for something to do, alarm for something late.

fields.label: Made Here
fields.description: Made by the workspace, not declared by a module. A migrate keeps it.
